summary: ansible-test shell opens an interactive shell in the same environment tests use, for example a Docker container or a venv with a given Python.
questions: How do I get a shell inside the ansible-test container?
How can I debug inside the ansible-test environment?

answer_card.title: Open an ansible-test shell
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible-test shell --docker                 # default container
ansible-test shell --venv --python 3.13     # Python 3.13 venv
```
